reasoning: All three findings of the first pass are closed in the artifacts: D3 records the check-run observation and makes the comparison order-insensitive, backed by a spec scenario and test; the review-and-merge requirement is cut to its tested sentence; Impact names the template. Every lost proof has a named catcher and no bespoke check is added.

simpler.evidence: D1 rejects keeping review_gate on the ruleset list (a stamp and verdict table over wait_for_pr's exit code); D2 rejects teaching the Stop hook v2 names (a new stamp); D3 rejects a repeatable --context flag (a typed name that never reported blocks merges) and keeping classic protection (two mechanisms plus a drift checker); D5 replaces --request with the native gh command it wraps. No simpler design survives the scenarios.

map.evidence: Eight delta scenarios, eight entries in tasks.md's map: Caller absent and Context not observed map to existing tests (test_activate_protection.py:174,192); Review caller present, Review context not observed, Read-back mismatch (new cases) and Read-back reorders contexts (test_read_back_reordered) are added in 1.1; review-and-merge/Push reads no protection and implementation/Push map to test_push_runs_ci_check_alone (1.2). The unchanged scenario 'PR weakens its own driver' keeps a test through the 3.2 rewrite.

red.evidence: 1.1's new tests fail against the single-context activate_protection.py (one context, ordered read_back at :220-243); 1.2's test_push_runs_ci_check_alone fails while pre-push:31-37 still runs check_branch_protection.py; 1.3 runs check_red.py and commits RED.

platform.evidence: D3 rests on GitHub Actions reporting `agent-review / agent-review` as a check run: recorded in D3 (PR 171 head f800f15a, github-actions, app id 15368, success), matching the reviewer's own check-runs read on 2026-09-24. The rulesets API's returned order of two contexts is stated as unobserved, and D3 and tasks 2.1 make read_back and owned_fields independent of it (sorted by context), covered by test_read_back_reordered. Multiple required_status_checks entries in one ruleset are the documented rule shape.

replaced.evidence: D3 replaces the fixed CONTEXT with a caller-presence input and lists its failure modes (never green, missing secret, caller added after activation) with the preflight refusal and the dry-run diff as catchers. D1, D2, D4 list each dropped guard (review_gate verdict and round budget, Stop gate, pre-push drift probe, TestDeclarationMatchesWorkflows) and what stops being proven; D4 states that after migration only the person's activate_protection --dry-run reads the installed ruleset, per ADR 0027.

catcher.evidence: Red or pending context: wait_for_pr.py exit 1 naming the check, or exit 3, on the settled head (task 6.3; test_delivery_scripts.py). Missing required context at merge: the ruleset, enforced by GitHub, after Migration step 1. Undeclared or never-green caller: activate_protection preflight refusal (exit 2, reads only) in Migration step 1. Round cap and v1 turn end: the person at merge (6.3 'Stop at three rounds', 6.4), as ADR 0027 decides.

length.evidence: review-and-merge 'No local hook reads protection': about 30 words; test_push_runs_ci_check_alone asserts the push half (hook runs only ci_check, no protection read); the merge half points at distribution's requirement, whose tests carry it. distribution 'Protection activation observes quality first' adds about 40 words, asserted by test_review_caller_present and test_review_context_not_observed. 'Activation reads back what it wrote' adds about 12 words ('exact set', 'in any order', 'lacks or adds a context'), asserted by the new read-back cases and test_read_back_reordered. implementation/Push edits one clause, asserted by the same pre-push test.

bespoke.evidence: Impact and design add no script or check: review_gate.py, delivery_state.py, check_branch_protection.py and install_branch_protection.py are deleted; request_codex_review.py loses --request and hooks.py/codex_hooks.py lose stop; activate_protection.py gains one pure contexts() in an existing script; skills/agent-process/templates/ruleset.json (now in Impact) changes its one-context placeholder to __REQUIRED_CHECKS__; the only added file is a test. Nothing enters additions.
